title: The 30 Seconds Apollo 11 Almost Crashed on the Moon #Shorts
description:
On July 20, 1969, Apollo 11 flashed an unexpected 1202 computer alarm minutes before touchdown while Neil Armstrong had under 30 seconds of fuel left to dodge a boulder field. Here is the true story of Houston Mission Control and the loneliest man in history orbiting the far side of the Moon.
